questions.syllabus_objective: The sample average in a regression setting; its standard error
questions.stem:
Consider the following Python code:
import numpy as np
from numpy.linalg import inv

# convert dataframe to matrix
y = df['LeadReal'].to_numpy()  # flat arrat
y = y[:, None]  # 2D array (matrix)
x = np.ones(y.shape)
nobs = x.shape[0]

# compute predicted
alpha_hat = inv(x.T @ x) @ x.T @ y
y_hat = x @ alpha_hat

# compute residuals to get sigma hat
res = y - y_hat
sigma_hat = 1/(nobs - 1)*res.T @ res
alpha_hat_se = np.sqrt(sigma_hat*inv(x.T @ x))
